note: What a server sends to tell everyone how far one seat has got through loading, and how it is holding up.

fields.name: progress
fields.note: How far through loading it is, from zero to one hundred.

fields.name: secondsLeft
fields.note: How much longer it is expected to take, in seconds.

fields.name: count
fields.note: How many times this has been reported for the seat.

fields.name: ping
fields.note: How long a message takes to reach the seat and come back, in milliseconds.

bits.name: ready
bits.note: Set where the seat has finished loading.
